Accepted Proof 2.1 repair: the positive-root-to-class map is followed by the class-to-reflection bijection in that direction. Current item matches reader-post. All six steps checked. Induction via N(us)={e_s} disjoint-union sN(u) yields exactly positive suffix roots and cardinality ell(w), with reversal producing positive prefix roots in N(w^{-1}). Faithful rho makes t_alpha representation independent. Since B(alpha,alpha)=1, r_alpha has (-1)-eigenspace R alpha even for degenerate B; equal reflections give proportional roots, and unit norm forces scalar +/-1. Thus each +/- class has exactly one positive root and both stated bijections hold. For strong exchange, the opened signed right-action supplier gives eta(x,uv)=eta(x,u)eta(u^{-1}xu,v). Conjugating a simple reflection proves eta(r,r)=-1; a putative shortening with eta(r,w)=+1 would make r shorten rw too, contradicting ell(rw)<ell(w). Prefix reflections are distinct, so deletion index is unique; its positive root is the corresponding prefix root in N(w^{-1}), with the left-shortening convention correct. Identity/empty S produce empty sets and vacuous exchange; no AC and no assumption ell(tw)=ell(w)-1. Björner–Brenti §4.4 pp.101–105, including complete proofs of 4.4.3–4.4.6, corroborates signs, recursion and dictionary; strong exchange is supplied independently by the local signed-action derivation, not imported from an exercise. Adjudicator also refreshed exact current supplier quotes and/or the omitted source/earlier-step input mappings in the audit contract; no item mathematics changed.

At m=5 the quartic factors as (2c-1)(c+1)(4c^2-2c-1), and c>1/2 selects c=(1+sqrt5)/4. Equal evaluation kernels force proportional roots, and unit norm plus positivity gives injectivity, so the finite root lists are exhaustive. At infinity u=e_s+e_t is nonzero radical and fixed by both generators; the two root strings exhaust Phi_+ by stability of their signed union. The two inversion formulas induct from k=0, including the empty j<=-1 range. Dual s(y_s)=-y_s and t(y_s)=2-y_s give translations and all intervals (j,j+1) for integer j; normalization by delta>0 gives exactly the open chamber cones, excludes integer trace endpoints and excludes nonzero delta=0 boundary points.
